title: KSDMA Historical Flood Return Probability raster bundle (10, 25 and 50 year labels)
publisher: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority (KSDMA); the catalogue cites UNEP, UN GRID, CIMA Italy, KSDMA (2020), and RMSI / National Insurance Academy (2024)
publication_date: Not stated for this exact ZIP; KSDMA catalogue cites 2020 and 2024 assessment references; TIFF archive timestamps are 2026-04-12
license: No dataset-specific licence or reuse terms found on the KSDMA catalogue page; ingestion and redistribution blocked pending confirmation
crs: EPSG:4326 / WGS 84, explicitly present in each GeoTIFF GeoKeyDirectory (GeographicTypeGeoKey 4326)
units: Raster is single-band float32; valid pixel-value units and meaning are not documented in TIFF metadata
geographic_coverage: Statewide raster grid bounding extent approximately 74.8646216-77.3680 E, 8.2909-12.7667 N; this is a grid extent, not a flood extent
limitations: KSDMA links the file as a historical flood return-probability raster product, not a live forecast.
Dataset-level reuse permission is not stated on the source catalogue; the archive is preserved raw but not unpacked into processed layers.

Each main TIFF declares GDAL_NODATA=-3.402823e38. Valid pixel values have no documented units or class meaning and range from 0.729 to 1776.6 (10-year), 0.6561 to 1974 (25-year), and 0.729 to 1981 (50-year); values cannot safely be thresholded or polygonized.
No exposure analysis is performed with this raster until reuse terms, valid pixel semantics, and the interpretation/application of the NoData sentinel are confirmed.

observed_pixel_review.validation_method: Read-only ZIP CRC check and Pillow GeoTIFF inspection. Pixel values were not assigned a meaning or modified.

zip_integrity: CRC check passed; all archive members readable
